3Draft

A compact 3D engine with a HEXAW-powered core, precise surface targeting and scenes stored as JSON. Materials lead the way — even interactive webpages and nested 3Draft scenes can become surfaces.

Terminal Is

AI AT THE WORKBENCH

Give your agent
real tools.

Build through MCP

3Draft exposes modelling operations directly to compatible AI agents. Create meshes, transform objects, apply booleans, inspect geometry and render the result. Open the live viewer and watch the scene take shape.

Explore the MCP server ↗
CODEX + 3DRAFTcodex mcp add 3draft -- node /absolute/path/to/3Draft/mcp/server.js

Use your local 3Draft checkout path. The server starts a live viewer for the agent’s scene.

Spider Paint × MCP

The next step is agent control of the complete application — scene navigation, modelling, vehicles and repeatable demonstrations. Follow its development on GitHub.
